messages:
Maya: quick heads-up 1: EU embeddings latency spike detected by monitoring. Product wants coordinated comms: status page, in-app banner, enterprise email, small social post. Plan to push initial Investigating post at 11:15 PT. @Priya can you draft the messaging? @Diego CS which customers should get the email?

Jon Ops: any idea on blast radius and ETA?

Ava Eng: looks like elevated queue time on the embeddings service in eu-west, affecting batch throughput. Rolling a scoped fix to a subset of hosts now. Expect partial improvement in ~30-40m, full recovery target ~90m. No evidence of data exposure. Will post updates at key milestones (50% recovery, mitigated).

Priya: suggested structure: short Investigating post that links to FAQ + support, brief enterprise email for Dedicated/Private, and 1-line banner text. Keep tone factual and calm. Drafts below.

Priya: Statuspage draft (Investigating)
```
Status: Investigating
Summary: Some customers in the EU region are experiencing reduced embeddings throughput and higher latency.
Impact: Embeddings API calls may be delayed or run slower for batch jobs; small percentage of requests may time out.
What were doing: Engineers are applying a targeted fix and monitoring results. No customer data exposure detected.
Advice: If you have scheduled batch jobs, consider postponing until we post an update.
Next update: within 30 minutes or when partial recovery is observed.
Link: https://status.redwood.ai
```

Priya: Enterprise email draft (Dedicated/Private customers)
```
Subject: Temporary embeddings throughput reduction in EU region 1: were deploying a fix
Hi, were investigating a temporary reduction in embeddings throughput in our EU region. Engineers are deploying a targeted fix now; partial recovery is expected in ~30-40 minutes. No customer data exposure has been identified. If this impacts SLAs, reply and well prioritize support.
```

Priya: In-app banner (one-liner)
```
Embeddings throughput in EU is currently degraded 1: were investigating. See status.redwood.ai for updates.
```

Diego CS: please ensure "no customer data exposure" line appears in all external comms and prep two canned replies: (1) job rerun guidance and (2) how to contact priority support. Also recommend including a short FAQ item on whether embeddings results are invalid (answer: results are intact; latency only).

Maya: timing plan: 11:15 PT status page Investigating, 11:16 PT in-app banner, 11:20 PT targeted enterprise email, 11:18 PT small X post linking to status. Can Ops/Eng confirm we can hit those times?

Jon Ops: will monitor rollout metrics and flag if patch misses 90m window.

Ava Eng: we can hit those windows. Ill post when we reach 50% throughput recovery and again on full mitigation with brief RCA or rollback note if needed. If rollback occurs, will include why we rolled back and next steps.

Maya: @Priya please make the status copy slightly less technical for public users and prepare a second, more technical update we can paste into the engineering channel for customers who request details. @Diego CS will you coordinate the enterprise recipient list?

Diego CS: yep, Ill DM the list and prep KB snippets now. Also prepping a short Slack thread template for customers so CS can respond quickly.

Priya: tweak: change "reduction" to "degradation" in the subject line, and swap "temporary" for "intermittent". Otherwise good to go.

StatusBot: Status draft queued to staging (ID: stg-9921). Preview: https://status.redwood.ai/staging/stg-9921

Maya: thanks all. Ill publish the Investigating entry at 11:15 PT and send the X post at 11:18 PT. Team, stand by for 11:45 PT check-in to confirm mitigation status. :loudspeaker::white_check_mark:

Ava Eng: will ping here when throughput >50% recovered.

Diego CS: KB and canned replies ready; will attach to the enterprise email for easy reference.

Jon Ops: keeping dashboards open and will escalate if we hit the 90m threshold.

Maya: publishing now.
